summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of ProximityRadar completed. All 14 backend pytest cases pass (auth register/login/me, profile & state updates, statuses CRUD, nearby with distance sort, radius filter, is_match complement graph, busy=no-matches). UI verified end-to-end on 390x844 mobile viewport: onboarding, login (tester@radar.com/secret123), register, radar animated blips with stats (Nearby/Aligned/Radius), status pill opens modal with 4 default statuses + custom vibe creation, broadcast updates status pill, match alert overlay 'Paths Crossed' appears after broadcasting a complementary status, Map tab shows expected 'Live map is device-only' web fallback with embedded nearby bottom sheet, You tab profile edit / visibility toggle / radius slider / sign out all work. Nearby tab reachable and rendered header + status pill. All 33 testIDs present in the app.

ui_bugs.issue: Pressable with testID and button-like styling has NO onPress handler. Users may tap the hint expecting it to open the status modal but nothing happens; the hint only tells them to tap the pill above. Either remove the Pressable wrapper (use a plain View) or wire onPress to router.push('/status'). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:90

issues: 'Nearby' count on Radar tab includes real registered accounts that share the same lat/lng because tests/dev leftover users are all seeded at Melbourne coords with visible=True. In production this will be fine, but for demos the count may be inflated. Consider filtering users whose last_active is older than N minutes in /api/nearby (server.py) so stale seeded accounts do not clutter the radar.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Wire onPress on radar-set-status-hint Pressable to router.push('/status') OR replace Pressable with View to remove misleading button affordance.
OPTIONAL: In GET /api/nearby, filter real users by last_active recency (e.g., last 15 minutes) to prevent stale test accounts from being returned.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py load_dotenv timing OK; JWT_SECRET read via os.environ (fails fast if missing) — good.
public_user helper correctly excludes hashed_password and Mongo _id.
Nearby endpoint uses haversine + bearing_between correctly and returns is_match per MATCH_GRAPH — verified against all 4 status permutations in tests.
Custom status key generation includes uuid suffix (avoids collisions) — good, but keys are never scoped per-user so all users share the same custom vibe list; acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
server.py is 337 lines, single-file, still under 700-line threshold — fine.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via context — checked; matches env var from frontend/.env.
All interactive elements (33 testIDs) properly annotated for testing.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified: onboarding, register, login, radar with blips+stats, status modal + custom vibe, broadcast updates pill, match alert overlay 'Paths Crossed' shown, Map fallback+nearby list, You tab edit/toggle/slider/logout; minor: radar-set-status-hint pressable has no onPress)

seed_data_creation: Registered a fresh UI user (uitest_<timestamp>@radar.com) and multiple backend TEST_ users during pytest runs; existing seed tester@radar.com/secret123 continues to work.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://nearby-connect-93.preview.emergentagent.com (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Seed account: tester@radar.com/secret123. Web fallback location: Melbourne (-37.8136, 144.9631). Mock users are relative to requester — always within ~180m — so nearby always returns 6-7 mocks at radius 200m. Match alert modal 'match-alert-modal' appears client-side via RadarContext polling (~6s) when a user with a complementary status is detected. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Only one minor UX inconsistency (radar-set-status-hint Pressable without onPress) reported.
